evidence: The enriched authored graph is the strongest macro-AUPRC result and ties the best micro-AUPRC baseline.

observation: The stored GPU experiment trains a two-layer GraphSAGE (128 hidden, 500 epochs, dropout 0.3, five seeds, 200 bootstrap resamples) on the committed split: 11,567 positives, 20% held out, five negatives per positive, hash seed 1729, 4,999 evaluation pairs. Enriched authored graph macro AUPRC 0.947 / micro 0.940, pruned 0.842/0.864, static 0.816/0.898, against logistic static 0.926/0.940. The write-up calls it a within-graph ablation: the static arm is a reduced authored graph, not the hosted Pharos baseline.
subject: F-19
title: GraphSAGE ablation is strong but within-graph
